create_skeleton_enum: create a Skeleton enum member from the COCO, GHUM, FACEMESH_TESSELATION_NO_IRIS, or FACEMESH_TESSELATION key point skeleton definitions
build_skeleton_edges: build the edges tuple for a specific skeleton like Skeleton.COCO or Skeleton.GHUM by accessing its value attribute
test_skeleton_by_edge_count: test the SKELETONS_BY_EDGE_COUNT mapping to look up skeleton edges by their edge count
test_skeleton_by_vertex_count: test the SKELETONS_BY_VERTEX_COUNT mapping to look up skeleton edges by their unique vertex count
summarize_skeleton_members: summarize all Skeleton enum members and their edge count and vertex count statistics
